use: S9 SCM runs: SCMTerrain.SetSoilParameters(Kphi, Kc, n, cohesion, friction, Janosi, elastic_K, damping_R) with the 'chrono' block of one set. Not part of the YAML / L1 / L2b fingerprints.

units.note: Chrono SI: Wong kN-based table x 1000 (Chrono forum 'SCM Terrain Parameter Units', survey [9b])

frame: SCM plane = crawler block-bottom plane (z = ground.crawler_bottom_z_m + 0.004, 3.11.2), normal +z body

chrono_source_checks.elastic_K_clamp: SetSoilParameters: m_elastic_K = max(elastic_K, Bekker_Kphi) (SCMTerrain.cpp:148-165); silent, no warning; numbers compared in different units unless n = 1; Kc/b not included. SoilParametersCallback values are used per hit node without this clamp (SCMTerrain.cpp:1394-1413)
chrono_source_checks.normal_law: elastic trial sigma = K (s - s_p); if sigma > sigma_yield: sigma = (oob Kc + Kphi) s^n, sigma_yield = sigma, s_p = s - sigma / K (SCMTerrain.cpp:1430-1458); then sigma += -Vn R (not clamped; the 'if (Vn < 0)' guard is commented out, 1459-1465)
chrono_source_checks.patch_b: hit nodes flood-filled into patches with 4-neighbours; per patch ChConvexHull2D of the node points m_delta (i, j): oob = perimeter / (2 area), oob = 0 if area < 1e-6 m^2 (SCMTerrain.cpp:1316-1378); matches rev. 45 (5.31.2)
chrono_source_checks.tangential: T = -(v - Vn N) normalised; zero tangential speed -> ChVector3::Normalize sets [1, 0, 0] (ChVector3.h:193); kshear += |v_t| dt, never decreases; tau = (c + sigma tan phi)(1 - exp(-kshear / Janosi)) along T: no static friction on pads/crawler

J1.name: heavy_clay_25
J1.label: J1 judgement: heavy clay (WES) 25 % moisture
J1.source: Wong, Theory of Ground Vehicles (Bekker 1969 WES data), survey table 1; imperial n 0.13 / kc 45 / kphi 140 / c 10 psi / phi 34 deg re-converted here (c 68.95 kPa; NASA TM 69.95 is a typo)
J1.basis_K: 2e8 Pa/m: P0 / S0 demo level (SynSCM Mid, Wheeled/Tracked demos); Lysmer analogue Vs 100 m/s gives 1.8e8; no measurement for this clay. Sensitivity 5e7 (low, still >> loading tangent) / 7e8 (Lysmer Vs 200 m/s, small-strain upper bound)
J1.basis_J: ASSUMPTION 0.01 m (Chrono demos / comment 'few mm or cm'); stationary pads: affects only the lateral force build-up, sensitivity 5 / 25 mm (bevameter range 5 ... 56 mm, survey [10])
conditions: c, phi are bevameter shear-ring values, not geotechnical c', phi' or c_u (survey [3][10])
p / q_ult <= 1/2 only with the drained reading (c = 68.95 kPa, phi = 34 deg); undrained (phi_u = 0, c as c_u) fails (p/q_u 2.6 / 2.8)
n = 0.13: 1 % pressure -> 7.7 % sinkage; Bekker plate data at <= 0.2 MPa, 1.1 ... 1.2 MPa is an extrapolation
J1.basis_R: rule 3.11.3: R = 2 zeta sqrt(K m / A_c), zeta 0.2 (YAML damping_ratio_heave_soil) on the crawler elastic heave branch, A_c from the P0 crawler settle on this set (C envelope, 20 mm, hull b); sensitivity 3e4 (Chrono demos), 3e5 / 6e5 (Lysmer analogue Vs 100 / 200 m/s)

G1.name: compacted_gravel_K30
G1.label: G1 compacted gravel / work platform (linear, K30-based)
G1.role: judgement candidate for stiffness (bearing to be confirmed by a field plate test)
G1.source: NOT a Bekker measurement. Substitute basis: plate-load modulus K30 (KS F 2310, 0.3 m plate) acceptance values (survey [16], secondary source): subgrade >= 147.1 / 196.1 MN/m^3, sub-base >= 294 MN/m^3, embankment >= 98.1 MN/m^3; Bowles k_s dense sand 64 ... 128 MN/m^3 [14]. SCM mapping n = 1, kc = 0, kphi = K30 (survey section 5, investigator's inference)
G1.basis_K: ASSUMPTION K = 2.3 kphi (reload / first-load ratio Ev2/Ev1 about 2.0 ... 2.5 for compacted granular layers, plate-test practice; general knowledge, not from the survey). K must exceed kphi for n = 1, otherwise Chrono silently sets K = kphi and the soil becomes elastic (no rut). Sensitivity 2.5e8 (1.7 kphi) / 7e8 (Lysmer Vs 200 m/s)
conditions: K30 is a secant at 1.25 / 2.5 mm settlement (about 0.18 ... 0.5 MPa); 1.1 ... 1.2 MPa with n = 1 is a linear extrapolation (real curve softens -> sinkage underestimated)
plate size: K30 plate 0.30 m vs pads B_sq 0.33 / 0.25 m; Terzaghi size factor for granular soil 0.92 / 1.23, inside the kphi sensitivity range (kc kept 0)
c = 0, phi 40 deg are ASSUMPTIONS for SCM shear only (dense gravel phi' 35 ... 45 deg)

bearing: presumed allowable dense gravel > 600 kPa (CPA, FS 2 in its example), compacted gravel 400 kPa (CICA), gravel 300 kPa long-term / 450 short-term (Korean rule, appendix 8): p 1.11 / 1.20 MPa is at or above q_ult implied by these tables -> field plate test to >= 1.5 MPa or a pad mat is required before G1 can be a judgement soil
G1.basis_R: rule 3.11.3: R = 2 zeta sqrt(K m / A_c), zeta 0.2 (YAML damping_ratio_heave_soil) on the crawler elastic heave branch, A_c from the P0 crawler settle on this set (C envelope, 20 mm, hull b); sensitivity 3e4 (Chrono demos), 3e5 / 6e5 (Lysmer analogue Vs 100 / 200 m/s)
